output.headline: Pays Everlast up to $9,200 for vegetation fire clearing at Thurgood Marshall Elementary School
output.summary: The district is hiring Everlast Development Inc. of Oakland to cut and haul away dry vegetation, clear weeds, and trim bushes, ivy and low branches along the fence line and around the grounds at Thurgood Marshall Elementary School, to meet the Oakland Fire Code. The price is $9,200, including a $3,000 contingency. Everlast was the lowest responsive bidder in a competitive bid, and work was scheduled to start July 26, 2021, before this approval, and end August 31, 2021.

output.headline: Adds $3,309.48 to Mar Con's Acorn Woodland playmatting contract and extends it to Nov. 10, 2020
output.summary: This change order adds rubber sheeting to prepare the site for playmatting at Acorn Woodland Elementary School. It raises the contract price from $113,200 to $116,509.48 and extends the end date from October 31, 2020 to November 10, 2020. The new end date was before this approval.

output.headline: Adds $2,117 to Mar Con's Emerson Child Development Center playmatting contract, extends to 2021
output.sourceIssueCandidate: The text gives the old end date as October 31, 2022, but the original period began September 16, 2020 and 207 days to May 26, 2021 fits an October 31, 2020 end date, so the year looks misprinted.
output.summary: This change order pays Mar Con Builders to do a site scan and preparation before new soft surface tiles are installed at Emerson Child Development Center. It raises the contract price from $57,600 to $59,717 and extends the term by 207 calendar days to May 26, 2021. The new end date was before this approval.

output.headline: Adds $12,122.87 to Mar Con's Global Family playmatting contract and extends it to May 2021
output.summary: This change order covers an extra utility site scan for the new playground location, asphalt installation, and capping and filling an existing drain at the old playground location. It raises the contract price from $88,320 to $100,442.87 and extends the term by 212 days to May 31, 2021. The new end date was before this approval.

output.headline: Pays Atlas Technical Consultants up to $49,908.10 for soil engineering at the Cole Administration Center
output.summary: The district is hiring Atlas Technical Consultants of Oakland for geotechnical (soil and ground) engineering and inspection services on the Cole Administration Center project. This includes reviewing submittals, site visits, soil sampling and lab testing, and checking daily field reports. The cap is $49,908.10, which includes a $4,537.10 contingency, and work runs from September 23, 2021 to December 31, 2023.

output.headline: Pays N.V. Heathorn up to $16,346 for steam pipe and tank repairs at The Center at Foster
output.summary: The district is hiring N.V. Heathorn Company of Concord for pipe and insulation work at The Center at Foster. This includes removing a stainless-steel chemical pipe from the steam header, capping it, and installing a new check valve at the feed water tank. The price is $16,346, and work runs from September 23, 2021 to December 31, 2021.

output.headline: Appoints a district representative to the BayTech Charter School governing board
output.summary: On the Charters Committee's recommendation, the Board is appointing a district representative to the BayTech Charter School Governing Board. The appointment is Shannon Ortland. No money is involved.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $20,400 for medical personnel at Oakland Athletic League high school sports events

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $20,400.00

output.summary: The district is ratifying (approving after the start date) a contract with an individual in Castro Valley to schedule and provide approved medical personnel at Oakland Athletic League high school sports events. The pay is up to 340 hours at $60 per hour, with a cap of $20,400, for July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2022. The contract period began before this approval.

output.headline: Adds $48,134.11 to Redgwick's Sherman Elementary playmatting contract and extends it to May 2021
output.summary: This change order pays Redgwick Construction Company to order and install added pieces to the play structure so it is age appropriate for children ages 2 to 12. It raises the contract price from $203,900 to $252,034.11 and extends the term by 197 days to May 31, 2021. The new end date was before this approval.

output.headline: Accepts $58,200 more from the Oakland Fund for Children and Youth for Summer Pre-K, extending to 2022
output.summary: This amends a grant agreement with the City of Oakland, adding $58,200 for the district's Summer Pre-K Program and raising the grant from $199,087 to $257,287. It also extends the grant period from May 31, 2021 to May 31, 2022. All other terms stay the same.

vendor.name: City of Oakland (Oakland Fund for Children and Youth)

output.headline: Expands T-Mobile student hot spot program to 10,000 lines through 2026, up to $2.33M total
output.summary: This amends the district's Project 10Million agreement with T-Mobile to add student hot spots and cellular service, for a combined total of 10,000 lines. The new terms run from September 23, 2021 to June 30, 2026, with a cap of $2,334,000 overall and $466,800 per year. The text gives only the overall cap, not the amount added by this amendment. It is paid from grant and E-Rate (federal school internet discount) funding.

output.headline: Creates a new job description for Supervisor, Warehouse and Distribution
output.summary: The Board is adopting a resolution that creates a new job description for a Supervisor, Warehouse and Distribution position. The text gives no dollar amount or details about the duties.

output.headline: Ratifies a no-cost agreement with Leaders Up for job search help for adult education students through 2024
output.summary: The district is ratifying a no-cost services agreement with Leaders Up of Los Angeles. Leaders Up will give job search help to Oakland Adult and Career Education students and host hiring events that connect employers with skilled students. It runs July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2024, and the contract period began before this approval.

output.headline: Approves a no-cost agreement with Love Never Fails for adult education instructors through 2024
output.summary: The district is approving a no-cost services agreement with Love Never Fails of Dublin. The group will provide instructors for College and Career Readiness classes for Oakland Adult and Career Education students, for agreed-upon hours. It runs July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2024.

output.headline: Leases Bridges Academy schoolyard to Trust for Public Land for a green schoolyard for 30 years
output.summary: The district is leasing the Bridges Academy site to Trust for Public Land for 30 years, from September 9, 2021 to September 9, 2051. The lease helps the group win a Statewide Park Program Proposition 68 grant, and lets it do community outreach, design and construction of green schoolyard improvements. The text states no dollar amount.

output.summary: The Board is ratifying (formally approving) the written minutes of its regular meeting of August 11, 2021. Staff prepared the minutes shortly after the meeting.
